how_it_works.headline: How JobCapturePro works
how_it_works.subheadline: Simple enough for the field. Strong enough for the office.

steps.title: Capture
lines: Crew snaps a photo in the app, or a completed job flows in from a connected workflow.

steps.title: Optimize
lines: JobCapturePro builds geotagged, local-ready check-in content from the job, photo, and location.

steps.title: Distribute
lines: Approved proof can update your website, Google, social, and directory.

steps.title: Convert
lines: Ask for the review on site with a QR — while the job is still fresh. (Not “automatic reviews.”)

testimonials.subheadline: We’re new. The product does the heavy lifting — quotes stay equal-weight, not oversized.

items.q: What does my crew actually have to do?
items.a: Capture the job (and show a QR for reviews when you use that flow). JobCapturePro handles the downstream proof.

items.q: We already have a CRM / CompanyCam. Do we need this?
items.a: Keep them. Those tools manage the job. JobCapturePro publishes the proof they usually don’t — Maps, website, social, directory, and the on-site review ask.
No. Rankings depend on many factors. JCP helps you publish consistent real-job proof that can support local visibility — it does not promise ranking outcomes.
It’s a photo check-in — not another portal. The review ask is a QR they show before they leave.

items.q: What am I getting in the demo?
items.a: Pick your trade and what you care about most. You’ll see a personalized JobCapturePro workflow in about 2 minutes. No credit card for the demo.

items.q: Can agencies run this for clients?
items.a: Yes. Same machine, client-ready proof from work their crews already finish. Start with the demo, then talk partner access if you want to productize it.
